exactRegistryVerification.basis: Stipulated perfectly accurate report for this bounded contract example. No reliability claim about an actual service is made.

observations.actualReportRule: A hypothetical branch is never appended to evidence. A performed investigation adds its source, actual observation, incurred fee and a new case revision; affected app results require reassessment.

noisyRegistryVerification.basis: Hypothetical 90% classification accuracy; either report remains logically possible in either transportation state.

missingRegistryVerification.basis: Hypothetical 90% exact response and 10% no response in either state; a missing response establishes neither registration nor nonregistration.

handoffRules.acceptedMeaning: A reviewer accepted this exact result hash and the case, module and evidence basis hashes. Changing a dependency makes that acceptance stale.
handoffRules.noEvidencePossibilities: Block the planning handoff; an inconsistent or empty basis never establishes a feasible plan.
handoffRules.incompleteAssessment: Preserve partial status and require further assessment; never interpret unvisited cases as failures or successes.
handoffRules.missingProbabilities: Planning remains available. Learning remains unavailable until a separate reviewed probability assessment is supplied.
handoffRules.zeroProbabilityState: Retain the state for mandatory operational eligibility; probability weight controls expected value only.

feeAccounting.meaning: Exactly one prospective fee in a hypothetical branch or exactly one incurred fee after an actual observation. The complete arrangement quote excludes it.
feeAccounting.budgetAndCashEffect: Planning checks both total expense and peak cash including this fee. Learning subtracts the fee once when comparing the investigation policy with acting now.
feeAccounting.authority: The declared study-purchase grant and cap are independent of the expense ceiling. Calculated benefit is not purchase permission.

boundaries: Contract fixtures and explicit handoff proof; not a workflow runner or generic adapter language.
The slow report arrives after reservation, so it cannot inform this two-stage reservation decision. A policy that reserves before a late report requires a future multi-stage policy capability.
Final shipment release, external booking, actual study purchase and multi-user approval execution remain separate actions.

# Canonical Decision Lab data. Rules are data, never executable code.
format: evidence-review/1
module:
  id: first-shipment-registration-evidence
  version: "1.0.0"
  title: Review ship-point registration
  metadata:
    catalog:
      domain:
        id: order-fulfillment
        label: Order fulfillment
        description: "Review delivery commitments, operating prerequisites and shipment arrangements."
      useCase:
        id: review-first-shipment
        label: Review a first shipment
        description: Review one shipment before committing money to an arrangement.
  description: "Determine whether the reviewed records establish transportation registration for this shipment, ship point, date and profile. A portal listing is compatible with registered and unregistered transportation states. Actual registry observations constrain those states; hypothetical future reports are not evidence."
  question: "Do these records establish that SP-A is transportation-registered for this shipment?"
  boundary: "One order revision, receiving location, direct ship point, effective date and profile version. The two declared transportation states exhaust the supported example. Accepted source observations are assumed accurate for this scope. Contradictory registry observations have no compatible explanation. No probabilities, spending authority or physical booking follow from this finding."
  assumptions: [The declared state directory is complete for this scoped claim. Portal presence does not imply transportation registration., An actual registry observation reports transportation registration accurately for the exact supplied scope., The shipment owner reviews the scope and source records before accepting an evaluation for a planning handoff., "Admissible explanations are possibilities, not probability weights. Multiple explanations must be deduplicated when projected to operating state identifiers."]
  parameters:
    - id: currentTime
      type: integer
      min: 0
      default: 480
      label: Current shipment review time
  relations:
    - id: scope
      source: basis
      columns:
        - id: id
          type: string
        - id: orderId
          type: string
        - id: orderRevision
          type: string
        - id: recipient
          type: string
        - id: shipDate
          type: string
        - id: profileVersion
          type: string
        - id: shipPoint
          type: string
      key: [id]
    - id: source
      source: basis
      columns:
        - id: id
          type: string
        - id: scope
          type: string
          references:
            relation: scope
            column: id
        - id: kind
          type: string
        - id: observedAt
          type: integer
        - id: description
          type: string
      key: [id]
    - id: state
      source: basis
      columns:
        - id: id
          type: string
        - id: scope
          type: string
          references:
            relation: scope
            column: id
        - id: portalListed
          type: boolean
        - id: registered
          type: boolean
      key: [id]
    - id: portalObservation
      source: evidence
      columns:
        - id: id
          type: string
        - id: scope
          type: string
          references:
            relation: scope
            column: id
        - id: value
          type: boolean
        - id: sourceId
          type: string
          references:
            relation: source
            column: id
      key: [id]
    - id: registryObservation
      source: evidence
      columns:
        - id: id
          type: string
        - id: scope
          type: string
          references:
            relation: scope
            column: id
        - id: value
          type: boolean
        - id: sourceId
          type: string
          references:
            relation: source
            column: id
      key: [id]
    - id: selectedState
      source: assignment
      columns:
        - id: stateId
          type: string
          references:
            relation: state
            column: id
      key: [stateId]
    - id: stateDetails
      source: derived
      columns:
        - id: stateId
          type: string
        - id: scope
          type: string
        - id: portalListed
          type: boolean
        - id: registered
          type: boolean
      key: [stateId]
    - id: recordMismatch
      source: derived
      columns:
        - id: observation
          type: string
        - id: field
          type: string
        - id: expected
          type: boolean
        - id: recorded
          type: boolean
      key: [observation]
  generation:
    - id: SELECT.TRANSPORTATION.STATE
      label: Consider each supported transportation state
      relation: selectedState
      from:
        relation: state
        column: id
      min: 1
      max: 1
  rules:
    - id: DESCRIBE.TRANSPORTATION.STATE
      head:
        relation: stateDetails
        args: ["?state", "?scope", "?portal", "?registered"]
      body:
        - relation: selectedState
          args: ["?state"]
        - relation: state
          args: ["?state", "?scope", "?portal", "?registered"]
    - id: PORTAL.RECORD.MISMATCH
      head:
        relation: recordMismatch
        args: ["?observation", portal_listed, "?expected", "?recorded"]
      body:
        - relation: portalObservation
          args: ["?observation", "?scope", "?recorded", "?source"]
        - relation: stateDetails
          args: ["?state", "?scope", "?expected", "?registered"]
        - op: ne
          args: ["?expected", "?recorded"]
    - id: REGISTRY.RECORD.MISMATCH
      head:
        relation: recordMismatch
        args: ["?observation", transport_registered, "?expected", "?recorded"]
      body:
        - relation: registryObservation
          args: ["?observation", "?scope", "?recorded", "?source"]
        - relation: stateDetails
          args: ["?state", "?scope", "?portal", "?expected"]
        - op: ne
          args: ["?expected", "?recorded"]
  admission:
    - id: ONE.SHIPMENT.SCOPE
      label: Review exactly one shipment scope
      when:
        - count:
            relation: scope
            args: ["?id", "?order", "?revision", "?recipient", "?date", "?profile", "?point"]
          as: "?scopes"
      assert:
        op: eq
        args: ["?scopes", 1]
    - id: SOURCE.ALREADY.OBSERVED
      label: The actual source record exists by the current review time
      when:
        - relation: source
          args: ["?source", "?scope", "?kind", "?at", "?description"]
      assert:
        op: lte
        args:
          - "?at"
          - parameter: currentTime
    - id: portalObservation.SOURCE.SCOPE
      label: The source record covers the same shipment claim
      when:
        - relation: portalObservation
          args: ["?id", "?scope", "?value", "?source"]
        - relation: source
          args: ["?source", "?sourceScope", "?kind", "?at", "?description"]
      assert:
        op: eq
        args: ["?scope", "?sourceScope"]
    - id: portalObservation.SOURCE.KIND
      label: Use the declared kind of actual source record
      when:
        - relation: portalObservation
          args: ["?id", "?scope", "?value", "?source"]
        - relation: source
          args: ["?source", "?sourceScope", "?kind", "?at", "?description"]
      assert:
        op: eq
        args: ["?kind", portal_capture]
    - id: registryObservation.SOURCE.SCOPE
      label: The source record covers the same shipment claim
      when:
        - relation: registryObservation
          args: ["?id", "?scope", "?value", "?source"]
        - relation: source
          args: ["?source", "?sourceScope", "?kind", "?at", "?description"]
      assert:
        op: eq
        args: ["?scope", "?sourceScope"]
    - id: registryObservation.SOURCE.KIND
      label: Use the declared kind of actual source record
      when:
        - relation: registryObservation
          args: ["?id", "?scope", "?value", "?source"]
        - relation: source
          args: ["?source", "?sourceScope", "?kind", "?at", "?description"]
      assert:
        op: eq
        args: ["?kind", actual_registry_report]
  constraints:
    - id: ALL.ACCEPTED.RECORDS.FIT
      label: This possibility agrees with every reviewed record
      when:
        - count:
            relation: recordMismatch
            args: ["?observation", "?field", "?expected", "?recorded"]
          as: "?mismatches"
      assert:
        op: eq
        args: ["?mismatches", 0]
  queries:
    - id: transport-registration
      label: "Is the direct ship point transportation-registered for this shipment?"
      kind: boolean
      body:
        - relation: stateDetails
          args: ["?state", "?scope", "?portal", true]
    - id: transport-state
      label: "Which transportation state remains possible?"
      kind: value
      body:
        - relation: stateDetails
          args: ["?state", "?scope", "?portal", "?registered"]
      select: ["?state"]
  reports:
    tables:
      - id: state-details
        label: Transportation state in this explanation
        relation: stateDetails
        columns: [stateId, registered, portalListed, scope]
      - id: portal-records
        label: Reviewed portal listing records
        relation: portalObservation
        columns: [id, value, sourceId, scope]
      - id: registry-records
        label: Actual transportation registry reports
        relation: registryObservation
        columns: [id, value, sourceId, scope]
      - id: conflicting-records
        label: Records this possibility cannot explain
        relation: recordMismatch
        columns: [observation, field, expected, recorded]
  presentation:
    findingGroups:
      - id: registration
        title: Transportation registration
        question: "What do the records establish about this ship point?"
        description: Review the supported registration finding and the operating states still possible.
        queryIds: [transport-registration, transport-state]
    explanationGroups:
      - id: transportation-state
        title: Transportation state

        description: Each retained explanation represents an operating state compatible with the reviewed record.
        items:
          - kind: table

definition.title: Complete a commitment
definition.responsibility: Find one complete static operating choice that satisfies every mandatory obligation across every explicitly admitted joint scenario, then compare feasible choices.
invariants: Choices are finite, input-only controls. One complete assignment is shared across every admitted scenario and obligation.
Admitted joint scenarios are explicit facts; neither independence, probabilities nor unlisted scenarios are inferred.
An empty admitted basis is inconsistent, never a vacuous feasibility result.
Typed acyclic expressions separate static controls, scenario consequences and post-scenario preference aggregates.
Activities, calendars, bookings and permission validity use half-open intervals; adjacent intervals do not overlap.
Capacity is the sum of simultaneous renewable demands. A scoped grant must cover its entire required operation.
Expense sums nonrefundable charges. Refundable holds affect cash only; simultaneous cash events are netted before peak cash is measured.

  description: "Compare complete direct and backup arrangements for one shipment. Check every admitted transportation state, reservation and receipt timing, complete preparation, shared resources, scoped release authority, expense and cash. A passing plan is a supported proposal, not a booking or authorization."
  question: "Which complete arrangement can meet this shipment commitment under every remaining transportation state?"
  template:
    id: complete-a-commitment
    version: 1
  units:
    time: minute
    timeOrigin: "Minute 0 is 2026-11-17T00:00:00-06:00; fixed UTC-06:00 for this bounded shipment horizon."
    money: USD cent
    count: unit of resource capacity
    quantity: case
  assumptions: ["This hypothetical case contains one accepted order revision for 100 cases, two complete mutually exclusive arrangements, and a fixed receipt commitment.", The listed operating states are a reviewed projection of the evidence result. No probabilities are inferred from evidence or used to remove a mandatory scenario., Direct transportation requires registered SP-A. The backup uses independently registered SP-B in either state. Portal presence does not establish transportation registration., "Each arrangement includes all packing, release and freight expense in its quoted fee. Preparation and resource use are explicitly checked and add no separate charge.", "The accepted 100 cases are stipulated to be available to either complete arrangement; this profile does not perform inventory allocation, manufacturing or replenishment.", "The complete issued-grant registry, calendar, bookings and quoted capacities remain stable. Computing a proposal does not purchase verification, reserve freight, grant permission or release stock.", "All tasks use half-open intervals. Packing starts when the arrangement can be selected; final release follows packing and must finish before the fixed offered departure.", "Reservation must be possible by minute 720, independently of receipt by minute 5340. Equal-time completion at either inclusive deadline is allowed.", "studyFee is one prospective or incurred verification fee counted once. The payment time is studyFeeAt, and the complete quoted arrangement fee is paid when that arrangement can be selected. There are no deposits, refunds, revenue or additional financing.", A complete static arrangement is assessed against every retained state. Learning may later choose among these complete arrangements only through separately checked report branches., A nonzero verification fee needs an independently recorded scoped purchase grant and study-purchase cap at its payment time. Missing authority cannot be replaced by available budget or positive expected benefit.]

      resources:

            ref: parameter.releaseActor
          amount:
            literal: 1
  resources:

      table: resources
      idColumn: id
      capacityColumn: capacity
    bookings:
      table: bookings
      resourceColumn: resource
      startColumn: start
      endColumn: end
      amountColumn: amount
  requirements:
    - id: SUFFICIENCY
      label: Complete accepted order
      meaning: The arrangement carries the accepted quantity using a transportation-registered ship point for this exact shipment scope.
      waivable: false
    - id: RESOURCES
      label: Preparation staff and workspace
      meaning: "Packing and release have the necessary capabilities, calendars and shared capacity for their complete durations."
      waivable: false
    - id: AUTHORITY
      label: "Purchase, arrangement and final release permission"
      meaning: "Recorded authorities cover verification purchase, arrangement selection and final release for the same order revision, recipient, shipment date and profile. A budget ceiling does not create permission."
      waivable: false
    - id: TIME
      label: "Reservation, preparation and receipt"
      meaning: "Select by the reservation cutoff, finish preparation before departure and meet the receipt deadline."
      waivable: false
    - id: ACCESS
      label: Receiving window
      meaning: Arrival falls within the declared half-open receiving window.
      waivable: false
    - id: COST
      label: Total expense and cash
      meaning: The quoted arrangement fee plus the single prospective or incurred verification fee stay within expense and peak-cash limits.
      waivable: false
  constraints:
    - id: capacity-for-complete-order

      kind: predicate

        args:

            table: arrangements
            where:

            column: capacity

    - id: scoped-transportation-registration

      kind: predicate
      predicate:
        op: exists
        table: readiness
        where:

            ref: scenario.stateId
          shipPoint:
            ref: derived.shipPoint
          registered:

          orderId:
            ref: parameter.orderId

            ref: parameter.recipient
          shipDate:

      predicate:
        op: exists
        table: capabilities
        where:

            ref: activity.pack.actor
          action:
            literal: pack
    - id: pack-availability
      requirement: RESOURCES
      kind: predicate
      predicate:
        op: interval-covered
        table: calendars
        where:
          actor:
            ref: activity.pack.actor
        start:
          ref: activity.pack.start
        end:

        startColumn: start

    - id: release-capability

        where:

          action:

    - id: release-availability

      kind: predicate
      predicate:
        op: interval-covered
        table: calendars
        where:

        start:

        where:

          orderRevision:
            ref: parameter.orderRevision
          recipient:

                - ref: parameter.actionReady
            - op: gt

                - ref: row.end

            ref: parameter.orderId
          orderRevision:
            ref: parameter.orderRevision
          recipient:
            ref: parameter.recipient
          shipDate:
            ref: parameter.shipDate
          profileVersion:
            ref: parameter.profileVersion
        test:
          op: and
          args:
            - op: lte
              args:
                - ref: row.start
                - ref: activity.release.start
            - op: gte
              args:
                - ref: row.end
                - ref: activity.release.end
    - id: selection-not-in-the-past

      kind: predicate
      predicate:
        op: gte
        args:
          - ref: parameter.actionReady
          - ref: parameter.currentTime
    - id: verification-fee-before-response

      predicate:

        args:

    - id: reserve-before-cutoff

        args:

    - id: receipt-within-access-window

    - id: total-expense-limit

      predicate:

    - id: peak-cash-limit

    - id: scoped-verification-purchase-grant

        op: or

            args:

          - op: and
            args:

                        - ref: parameter.studyFeeAt
                    - op: gt
                      args:
                        - ref: row.end

      - id: complete-arrangement-fee

  preference:

assumptions: This hypothetical case contains one accepted order revision for 100 cases, two complete mutually exclusive arrangements, and a fixed receipt commitment.
The listed operating states are a reviewed projection of the evidence result. No probabilities are inferred from evidence or used to remove a mandatory scenario.
Direct transportation requires registered SP-A. The backup uses independently registered SP-B in either state. Portal presence does not establish transportation registration.
Each arrangement includes all packing, release and freight expense in its quoted fee. Preparation and resource use are explicitly checked and add no separate charge.
The accepted 100 cases are stipulated to be available to either complete arrangement; this profile does not perform inventory allocation, manufacturing or replenishment.
The complete issued-grant registry, calendar, bookings and quoted capacities remain stable. Computing a proposal does not purchase verification, reserve freight, grant permission or release stock.
All tasks use half-open intervals. Packing starts when the arrangement can be selected; final release follows packing and must finish before the fixed offered departure.
Reservation must be possible by minute 720, independently of receipt by minute 5340. Equal-time completion at either inclusive deadline is allowed.

studyFee is one prospective or incurred verification fee counted once. The payment time is studyFeeAt, and the complete quoted arrangement fee is paid when that arrangement can be selected. There are no deposits, refunds, revenue or additional financing.
A complete static arrangement is assessed against every retained state. Learning may later choose among these complete arrangements only through separately checked report branches.

assumptions: This hypothetical case contains one accepted order revision for 100 cases, two complete mutually exclusive arrangements, and a fixed receipt commitment.

Direct transportation requires registered SP-A. The backup uses independently registered SP-B in either state. Portal presence does not establish transportation registration.
Each arrangement includes all packing, release and freight expense in its quoted fee. Preparation and resource use are explicitly checked and add no separate charge.
The accepted 100 cases are stipulated to be available to either complete arrangement; this profile does not perform inventory allocation, manufacturing or replenishment.
The complete issued-grant registry, calendar, bookings and quoted capacities remain stable. Computing a proposal does not purchase verification, reserve freight, grant permission or release stock.
All tasks use half-open intervals. Packing starts when the arrangement can be selected; final release follows packing and must finish before the fixed offered departure.
Reservation must be possible by minute 720, independently of receipt by minute 5340. Equal-time completion at either inclusive deadline is allowed.

studyFee is one prospective or incurred verification fee counted once. The payment time is studyFeeAt, and the complete quoted arrangement fee is paid when that arrangement can be selected. There are no deposits, refunds, revenue or additional financing.
A complete static arrangement is assessed against every retained state. Learning may later choose among these complete arrangements only through separately checked report branches.

A nonzero verification fee needs an independently recorded scoped purchase grant and study-purchase cap at its payment time. Missing authority cannot be replaced by available budget or positive expected benefit.
